title: Fail closed on stale recovery until the generation fence is proven
mission: Add a temporary evidence-gated recovery interlock to the universal worker allocator: while single-winner recovery-generation fencing is not proven operational, workers that reach stale-recovery selection must not mint a new recovery owner. They should persist a typed RECOVERY_BLOCKED_UNSAFE_GENERATION_FENCE boundary and continue to normal READY allocation or deduplicated discovery. Remove/bypass the interlock only from exact durable fence-canary evidence.
problem: The live mass canary has already produced overlapping active recovery generations for one stale opportunity. The append-only recovery-attempt path is evidence-safe but is not itself a single-winner authority fence. Continuing to let arbitrary fresh /wc workers issue recovery claims before that fence is operational can create duplicate active owners.
acceptance: When recovery-generation-fence capability lacks evidence-backed operational status, stale-recovery selection emits a durable RECOVERY_BLOCKED_UNSAFE_GENERATION_FENCE boundary instead of creating a recovery claim.
Normal READY opportunity allocation and deduplicated proposal discovery remain available after the boundary, so the interlock does not turn one unsafe subsystem into global worker idling.
The interlock is bypassed only when an exact concurrent-start canary proves at most one active recovery generation and loser reconciliation; file/spec existence alone is insufficient.
Existing original/recovery claims, runs, late returns and immutable evidence are never rewritten or discarded.
A regression test reproduces the known double-recovery shape and proves the pre-fence allocator fails closed rather than minting a third active owner.

goal_relevance.reason: The active human workflow is a high-parallelism identical-/wc canary; a fail-closed guard prevents stale recovery from converting useful parallelism into duplicate mutation authority while the permanent fence is still candidate work.

regression_prevention.reason: The failure is no longer hypothetical: two active recovery generations were durably observed for one opportunity. The interlock contains that class immediately without claiming the permanent fence is already built.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Fresh workers can self-bound and continue other useful work instead of requiring the human/guide to notice and arbitrate duplicate recoveries during the mass wave.

reversibility.reason: This is a temporary fail-closed policy gate. It can be automatically bypassed once the permanent generation-fence canary is evidence-backed, without rewriting recovery history.

falsification: A worker can still create a new recovery claim while the single-winner generation fence has no operational canary evidence.
The interlock blocks ordinary READY allocation or proposal discovery after refusing unsafe recovery.
The interlock treats a fence spec/file as operational proof without a concurrent-start exercise receipt.
The interlock rewrites or deletes prior recovery evidence.
Once a valid fence canary exists, the interlock cannot deterministically allow safe recovery again.
dedup_note: This intentionally does not duplicate the already-pinned permanent single-winner recovery-fence work. That work fixes recovery ownership. This proposal is a temporary safety interlock for the interval before that fix is evidence-backed operational: fail closed on recovery but keep allocating unrelated safe work.
